judgments.justification: “highest average win rate…at round 5 for both Llama3-8B… and Gemma2-2B” matches the reported rankings.
It compares Method M with Max-Reward only at round 5, not across the earlier model-round combinations.
It claims superiority over other baselines only at round 5, not across every reported model-round combination.
“remained close to the seed model…indicating no substantial degradation” is supported by Method M being descriptively above every corresponding seed value.
It does not compare Method M’s alignment-tax accuracy with other filters.
“no statistical tests were reported” and differences “cannot be claimed as significant or reliable” accurately convey the statistical-reliability limitation.
It does not discuss Mono versus Mult-Full or Method M.
“highest average win rate…at the final round for both models” correctly reports Method M’s round-5 standing and values.
“lower for Llama3-8B” at R3–R4 but “higher for Gemma2-2B,” together with final-round superiority, reports the mixed pattern.
It does not compare Method M against Mult-Full, Rand, UAB, and LCL across all model-round combinations.
“did not degrade…relative to the seed model” is supported by all four stated Method M accuracies exceeding their corresponding seed values.
Although “not uniformly the best” is correct, “higher than Rand” reverses Gemma MMLU: Method M’s 39.18% is below Rand’s 39.73%.
It provides no single-run, confidence-interval, significance-test, or statistical-reliability caveat.
It does not discuss Mono versus Mult-Full or Method M.
“highest reported win rate at round 5 for both Llama3-8B…and Gemma2-2B” correctly states Method M’s final-round ranking.
It reports Llama’s R3 deficit but omits that Method M also trailed Max-Reward for Llama at R4.
It does not compare Method M with Mult-Full, Rand, UAB, and LCL across every model-round combination.
The quoted Method M and seed values show Method M descriptively above the seed on both benchmarks for both models.
It does not compare Method M’s knowledge and reasoning accuracies with other filters.
“No statistical tests were reported” and differences “cannot be claimed as significant or reliable” correctly communicate the lack of established reliability.
It does not discuss Mono versus Mult-Full or Method M.
